title: Installing the control plane and adding worker nodes

videos.script: A managed provider hands you an API server and hides the rest. Lesson 46 counted what that saves. This lesson is the rest. {{hidden}} Every kind cluster in this course was built by kubeadm, the same tool people use on their own machines, and it is still inside each node. {{kubeadm}} You will read what it laid down on the control plane, and remove a worker and join it back with a token. Then you will take a backup of etcd, delete something, and restore the whole cluster to the moment before. {{plan}}
